sn12.17:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn12.17:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahe piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn12.17:1.4: addasā kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
sn12.17:1.5: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn12.17:1.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.17:1.7: puccheyyāma mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ kañcideva desaṃ sace no bhavaṃ gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
sn12.17:2.1: dutiyaṃpi kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.17:2.2: puccheyyāma mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ kañcideva desaṃ sace no bhavaṃ gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
sn12.17:2.7: evaṃ vutte acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.17:2.8: na kho pana mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ bahudeva pucchitukāmāti.
sn12.17:3.1: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama sayaṃkataṃ dukkhanti.
sn12.17:3.3: kiṃ pana bho gotama parakataṃ dukkhanti.
sn12.17:3.5: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama sayaṃkatañca parakatañca dukkhanti.
sn12.17:3.7: kiṃ pana bho gotama asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhanti.
sn12.17:3.9: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama natthi dukkhanti.
sn12.17:3.12: tenahi bhavaṃ gotamo dukkhaṃ na jānāti na passatīti.
sn12.17:3.13: na khvāhaṃ kassapa dukkhaṃ na jānāmi na passāmi
sn12.17:4.1: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama sayaṃkataṃ dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ kassapāti vadesi
sn12.17:4.2: kiṃ pana bho gotama parakataṃ dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ kassapāti vadesi
sn12.17:4.3: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama sayaṃkatañca parakatañca dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ kassapāti vadesi
sn12.17:4.4: kiṃ pana bho gotama asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ kassapāti vadesi
sn12.17:4.5: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama natthi dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno na kho kassapa natthi dukkhaṃ atthi kho kassapa dukkhanti vadesi
sn12.17:4.6: tenahi bhavaṃ gotamo dukkhaṃ na jānāti na passatīti iti puṭṭho samāno na khvāhaṃ kassapa dukkhaṃ na jānāmi na passāmi
sn12.17:4.9: ācikkhatu ca me bhante bhagavā dukkhaṃ
sn12.17:4.10: desetu ca me bhante bhagavā dukkhanti.
sn12.17:5.1: so karoti so paṭisaṃvedayatīti kho kassapa ādito sato sayaṃkataṃ dukkhanti iti vadaṃ sassataṃ etaṃ pareti.
sn12.17:5.2: añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedayatīti kho kassapa vedanābhitunnassa sato parakataṃ dukkhanti iti vadaṃ ucchedaṃ etaṃ pareti.
sn12.17:5.3: ete te kassapa ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti
sn12.17:6.1: evaṃ vutte acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.17:6.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya …pe… cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
sn12.17:6.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn12.17:6.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn12.17:7.1: yo kho kassapa aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena parivutthaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū ākaṅkhamānā pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya
sn12.17:8.1: sace bhante aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena parivutthaparivāse āraddhacittā bhikkhū ākaṅkhamānā pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena parivutthaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
sn12.17:9.1: alattha kho acelo kassapo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
sn12.17:9.2: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
sn12.17:9.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn12.17:9.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā kassapo arahataṃ ahosīti.
